title: 设置某一列的字体为红色
author: chencs0603

comments.body: 确认下 有没有调用进来？

非常感谢!
即把CellStyle cellStyle = cell.getCellStyle();这行代码改成CellStyle cellStyle = writeSheetHolder.getSheet().getWorkbook().createCellStyle();即可

satisfaction_conditions: A working solution to set the font color to red for the first column (excluding header) in EasyExcel
Proper cell style creation method in EasyExcel's CellWriteHandler implementation
Guidance on correct font color configuration for Excel cells when using EasyExcel's handlers

_classification.category: Can be dockerized without any issue

git_commit_info.message: 支持通过模板填充数据
git_commit_info.author: Jiaju Zhuang

dockerfile:
FROM openjdk:8-jdk

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Install required tools
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y git maven && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Clone the repository and checkout specific commit
RUN git clone https://github.com/alibaba/easyexcel.git . && \
    git checkout 132bd8efa992f67f2eb1694c62d2bf0a7e64fbbb

# Skip GPG signing which is causing the build to fail
RUN mvn clean install -DskipTests -Dgpg.skip=true

# Set environment variables
ENV JAVA_HOME=/usr/local/openjdk-8
ENV PATH=$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH

# The workspace is ready for the user to validate the issue
CMD ["bash"]
